targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(commits_count) as value FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN message_quality THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as value FROM commit_metrics WHERE commit_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT u.name as usuario, COUNT(c.id) as commits, SUM(c.additions) as agregadas, SUM(c.deletions) as eliminadas, ROUND(COUNT(c.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(c.commit_date)), 0), 2) as commits_por_dia FROM commit_metrics c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.commit_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND u.is_bot = false GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY commits DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT metric_date as time, SUM(commits_count) as value FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as fecha, p.name as proyecto, u.name as usuario, metric_name as metrica, ROUND(metric_value, 2) as valor, severity as severidad FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND a.is_resolved = false ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
